comment: The serve argv the IDE builds (BACKLOG #5566, #5939). serve has serviceConfig set; serveDefault has messagefoundry.serviceConfig at its default; copyLine is the copied start command with serviceConfig set. configDir is not the default, so a pin of it reads the setting rather than a fallback. ide/src/test/suite/b20008-b-serve-argv.test.ts pins buildServeInvocation and serveCommandLine against these, and b20008-b-start-wiring.test.ts pins the argv the real status bar Start launches serve with. tests/test_b20008_b_ide_serve_argv.py reads serve and serveDefault with the engine's own parser.
